periods.time: Shortly after Ikki wakes in Hagun infirmary

name.zh: 黑铁严授权救援史黛菈
name.en: Itsuki Authorizes the Stella Rescue Team

periods.type: command decision / family conflict / rescue launch
periods.location: Hagun Academy infirmary and Japan Branch command network
periods.summary: Itsuki stops Ikki from rushing out blindly, locates Eilands through satellite records, and formally authorizes a five-person team to rescue Stella under Japan Branch responsibility.
periods.cause: Ikki reports that Karl Eilands abducted Stella for his own purpose, and Stella's location is initially unknown while international politics would delay official Union action.
periods.process: Ikki, Shizuku and Ouma nearly clash when Itsuki forbids unsanctioned action. Itsuki clarifies that he is not forbidding rescue, only reckless solo pursuit. He orders satellite analysis, determines Eilands likely remains inside Japan, and sends Ikki, Shizuku, Ouma, Touka and Alice after the target. He states that all damages and problems caused by the rescue will be his responsibility as Japan Branch head.
periods.outcome: The route points north to Nikko, Tochigi. Ouma and Touka provide speed, Shizuku fuses with Ikki to heal him en route, and Alice travels in Ikki's shadow as infiltration support.
periods.significance: Marks Itsuki's shift from rigid obstruction to active paternal support and creates the rescue party that reaches Stella before Eilands fully succeeds.
